const r = await tools.pwsh({
  description: "Extract remaining nowcoder course prices",
  command: `cd "D:\\GitHub\\My-second-brain\\50-知识\\AI工具\\_scripts"
$t = Get-Content "_b_nc_course.html" -Raw -Encoding UTF8
$p = [regex]::Replace($t,'<script[\\s\\S]*?</script>','')
$p = [regex]::Replace($p,'<[^>]+>','|')
$p = [regex]::Replace($p,'\\|+','|')
$p = [regex]::Replace($p,'\\s+',' ')
Write-Host $p.Substring(4000,[Math]::Min(3500,$p.Length-4000))
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "=== 课程价格列表 ==="
[regex]::Matches($p,'￥[0-9.]+') | %{ $_.Value }`,
  timeoutMs: 40000
});
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? r.stdout.text : JSON.stringify(r));
